Apprentice.name: Blinding Flash
Apprentice.effect:
Send a blinding flash of light at a creature. It must make a Fortitude save 
 Success: Target is dazzled for one turn.
 Failure: Target is blinded for one turn and dazzled for one minute 
 Critical Failure: Target is blinded for one minute
While affected by this spell, the target can spend one action to attempt to redo the save, removing the remaining effects on a success.

Apprentice.actions: , when you would have to make a Reflex save to an attack by a metal weapon or projectile.
Apprentice.effect:
Attempt to move the metal out of the way. 
Use the Spellshaping check instead of making a Reflex Saving Throw

Apprentice.name: Darken
Apprentice.actions: -
Apprentice.effect:
Creates a 3x3 tiles square zone of darkness that blocks out non-magical lights. 
If you spend 3 actions on this spell, the zone is 5x5 tiles.

weapons.name: Glaive
weapons.description: A pole weapon with a single edged blade, favored by infantry for its versatility

actions.name: Fierce Dive
actions.requirement: The Wyvern rider is mounted on a wyvern that's airborne and not immobilized.
actions.effect: The wyvern dives, Flying twice to end up at a lower elevation than it started. At the end of the movement the rider can make a Glaive attack with a +2 bonus.

actions.name: Act Together
actions.effect: The Rider and Wyvern both takes 1 action.

actions.name: Evasive Maneuver
actions.requirement: The Wyvern rider is mounted on a wyvern that's airborne and not immobilized. Once per minute
actions.effect: The Rider commands the Wyvern to dodge. The Rider and the Wyvern get a +2 bonus to Reflex saves until the start of its next turn. The Wyvern Flies.
